domain: Social Ritual / Interior Life / Domestic Power Structures
topic_summary: A narrative set in a spa-town season depicts three parallel systems of concealed labor beneath visible ritual: a wife's nightly private discipline of grief-observance that structures her entire performed day, a husband's unexamined confidence that his wife's contentment is a settled account requiring no audit, and a spa-town economy of manufactured warmth (Frau Nemcová's hospitality, Dr. Reiner's 'impartial' nod-ordering) that converts invisible calculation into apparently spontaneous social fact. The narrative's turn occurs when the wife's private ritual is witnessed and named aloud, converting it from a self-sufficient private fact into a narrated possession — after which it can no longer function as it did.

key_entities: Klára (wife; maintains nightly private ritual honoring a dead first attachment)
Rittmeister Anton Vesely (husband; holds unexamined belief that absence-of-complaint equals contentment)
Frau Nemcová (pension-house keeper; produces commercial warmth indistinguishable from genuine welcome)
Dr. Reiner (physician; believes his patient-ordering is impartial while it silently tracks status)
the rosewood box / brass latch (object; site of ritual, never opened, never explained)
the fixed schedule (structural entity; the town's hour-by-hour social choreography)
key_claims: Klára's ritual costs her nothing to perform because it requires no belief-conversion, only bodily habit
Anton genuinely believes his wife's account 'stands in credit' because no complaint has ever been registered against it
Frau Nemcová's warmth arrives before the calculation that produces it, making the labor invisible even to a sympathetic observer
Reiner sincerely believes his waiting-room order is fair, unaware it silently reprices around a councillor father's appointment
Once spoken aloud, the ritual's nature changes irreversibly from private fact to narrated account, even though no external circumstance changed
key_tensions: Private ritual sustained by silence vs. the same ritual once witnessed and required to become language
Anton's ledger-model of marital contentment (present because unaudited) vs. the actual unaudited cost accruing beneath it
Performed spontaneous warmth (Nemcová, the promenade face) vs. its actual constructed, priced, effortful substrate

axes.human_readable: Silence-Dependent Ritual Integrity (Private Fact Destroyed by Utterance)
axes.structural_delta: A recurring private act retains its structural identity only so long as it remains unspoken; the act of naming it aloud does not merely reveal it but ontologically converts it into a different object — a narrated account — even though no external fact has changed.
axes.primary_observable: Presence or absence of verbal articulation of the ritual to a third party; measurable shift in the actor's own relationship to the act post-utterance (Klára's 'no longer the thing it had been')
axes.selection_reason: Highest thematic centrality; the narrative's actual turning mechanism. Distinct observable (utterance event) not shared by any other axis.

axes.human_readable: Unaudited Contentment as Entitlement (Absence-of-Complaint Mistaken for Settled Account)
axes.structural_delta: An authority figure (spouse, institution) treats the absence of visible complaint as positive proof of adequacy, structurally exempting himself from ever having to investigate what the arrangement actually costs the party who sustains it — until an accident of visibility forces partial recognition without full correction.
axes.primary_observable: Frequency and content of Anton's internal accounting statements about Klára's 'credit balance'; whether he ever inquires into her interior cost versus merely inferring it from her behavior
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (audit behavior, not utterance) and distinct beneficiary/victim structure; causally upstream of the disclosure crisis without being reducible to it.

axes.human_readable: Performed Spontaneity as Extractable Labor (Warmth Manufactured to Appear Costless)
axes.structural_delta: Social and commercial systems require the appearance of unlabored, spontaneous affect (welcome, deference, impartial ranking) precisely because visible calculation would destroy its value; the labor of producing this appearance is real, priced, and exhausting, but structurally invisible to those who consume it, including sympathetic observers.
axes.primary_observable: Gap between the actor's internal calculation (Nemcová's pricing of thirty more mornings of warmth; Reiner's unconscious status-reordering) and the external perception of spontaneity by recipients
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (the arrival-timing of affect relative to its triggering event) generalizes across three separate characters (Nemcová, Reiner, Klára's promenade face), establishing it as an independent structural pattern rather than incidental to either selected axis.

axes.human_readable: Status-Ordering Disguised as Impartial Mechanism (Rank Recalculated Through a Falsely Neutral Procedure)
axes.structural_delta: A nominally neutral procedural order (physician's waiting-room, dinner seating) silently re-sorts itself around status information while the party administering it sincerely believes the sorting reflects only its stated neutral criterion.
axes.primary_observable: Correlation between newly acquired status information (the judge's father's appointment) and reordering of nod-sequence or seating, absent any acknowledgment of the correlation by the administering party
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: largely a special case/instance feeding the broader performed-spontaneity dynamic; distinct but lower independent yield than the three selected axes given the 3-axis structure.

axes.human_readable: Fixed Schedule as Substrate for Interior Divergence (Ritual Time Enabling Private Time)
axes.structural_delta: A rigid, externally imposed timetable of social obligation is not merely constraining but structurally enabling — it frees the body to perform without requiring the mind's presence, thereby carving out the interior space in which a wholly separate, unscheduled private commitment can be sustained indefinitely.
axes.primary_observable: Degree to which scheduled activity is described as automatic/bodily ('the fingers go without the mind's help') versus the attention reserved for the unscheduled hour
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: functions as background/mountain condition enabling axis 1 rather than an independently extractive dynamic; low centrality relative to selected set.

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Neutral procedure silently re-sorts around status while administrator believes it neutral
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Substantially captured as a specific instance within performed_spontaneity_as_extractable_labor; lower independent centrality

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Rigid external schedule frees the body to perform automatically, enabling a separate unscheduled private commitment
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Functions as enabling background condition for the primary disclosure dynamic rather than an independently extractive axis

omegas.description: The narrative deliberately withholds the box's contents ('nothing in the box you would call evidence'). Whether the ritual's ε changes because of disclosure or because disclosure merely reveals a pre-existing fragility that was always present is undecidable from the text.

Anton's closing silence is explicitly presented as ambiguous by the narrator ('might have been the first real quiet... or might, with equal justice, have been nothing more than a story taking its time to finish forming'). Whether unaudited_contentment_as_entitlement axis resolves toward genuine reckoning or toward mere anecdote-harvesting for future social capital is left open by the source and should not be resolved definitively in generation.
omegas.source: F01 (Premise Drift) risk check — narrative explicitly refuses closure here

omegas.description: Frau Nemcová's commercial performed-warmth and Dr. Reiner's status-blind status-sorting are structurally similar (invisible labor / invisible bias) but operate through different mechanisms (self-conscious pricing vs. sincere self-deception). Generation should preserve this distinction rather than collapsing both into a single 'hidden labor' story.
